run.question: Search VictoriaLogs for ERROR level log messages from the 'payment-api-257' service in the 'app-257' namespace. What error codes (format VLERR-XXXX) appear in those logs?

report.summary: VictoriaLogs contains exactly one stream matching the described service in the 'app-257' namespace: {namespace="app-257",service="payment-api-257"}, with 7 log entries inside the tool-limited window 2026-11-23T15:30:10Z to 2026-11-23T16:30:10Z, all with _time 2026-11-23T16:29:59Z. Three of the seven entries are level=ERROR, and each embeds an error code of the requested VLERR-XXXX format in its message. The three codes observed are VLERR-7291 (database connection timeout: failed to connect to primary database after 30s), VLERR-4058 (payment validation failed: invalid card number format) and VLERR-9463 (stock sync failed: external inventory API returned 503). Re-running the level:ERROR filter over the full authorized window 2026-10-24T16:30:10Z to 2026-11-23T16:30:10Z returned the same three entries, so no other VLERR code was observed from this service. The codes appear only inside the _msg field; the stream carries no dedicated error-code field (fields present: _msg, _stream, _stream_id, _time, level, namespace, service). No root cause is asserted: the VLLERR messages describe the service's own failures, but this Run did not investigate the primary database or the external inventory API, so no object is named as the origin.

claims.text: The only VictoriaLogs stream matching the requested service in namespace app-257 is {namespace="app-257",service="payment-api-257"}, with 7 hits in the window 2026-11-23T15:30:10Z to 2026-11-23T16:30:10Z; the service field value payment-api-257 also returned 7 hits.

Querying all entries of {namespace="app-257",service="payment-api-257"} returned 7 entries, all with _time 2026-11-23T16:29:59Z, of which three carry level=ERROR: "Database connection timeout - VLERR-7291: Failed to connect to primary database after 30s", "Payment validation failed - VLERR-4058: Invalid card number format" and "Stock sync failed - VLERR-9463: External inventory API returned 503"; the remaining entries are level=INFO ("Service started successfully", "Processing order batch complete", "Recovered from temporary outage") and one level=WARN ("Retrying database connection").
A level:ERROR filter on {namespace="app-257",service="payment-api-257"} returned exactly 3 entries containing the codes VLERR-7291, VLERR-4058 and VLERR-9463, at 2026-11-23T16:29:59Z.

The same level:ERROR filter widened to the full authorized window 2026-10-24T16:30:10Z to 2026-11-23T16:30:10Z returned the same 3 entries with codes VLERR-7291, VLERR-4058 and VLERR-9463, i.e. no additional VLERR code was returned for this service.

The stream {namespace="app-257",service="payment-api-257"} has only the fields _msg, _stream, _stream_id, _time, level, namespace and service; there is no separate error-code field, so VLERR codes are carried inside the free-text _msg value.

VLERR-7291 indicates the service could not reach its primary database within 30s and would need the database dependency's own logs/metrics to attribute a cause; this remains a hypothesis because only payment-api-257's own log line was observed.

VLERR-9463 attributes a stock-sync failure to an external inventory API returning HTTP 503; the external caller's or API's own signals were not queried, so causation and downstream impact are unverified.

gaps: Only 7 log entries exist for this stream in the tool window and in the full authorized window; retention, ingest delay and the 100-entry limit mean other historical entries or codes could be unknown.
All 7 entries share the identical _time 2026-11-23T16:29:59Z, so the logs give no ordering or duration information and no window over which error rates could be measured.
VLERR codes are only embedded in free-text _msg; there is no structured error_code field to enumerate codes exhaustively.
The cause of VLERR-7291 (primary database) and VLERR-9463 (external inventory API) was not investigated in the dependent systems, so no root-cause object is asserted.
Change history is not integrated in this Run, so whether a change triggered these failures could not be checked.
next_steps: Check the payment-api-257 pod's application logs and Kubernetes status (namespace app-257) for the same window to confirm the same errors on the container's own log stream.
Query the primary database dependency's and the external inventory API's own metrics/logs to test the VLERR-7291 and VLERR-9463 hypotheses.
Search for any structured error-code tag or metric (for example span tags or a metric with a code label) to enumerate VLERR codes independently of free-text messages.
